stories.title: October inflation report today at 8:30am ET
stories.summary: The US consumer price report for October comes out Tuesday at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok). It shapes whether the Fed raises rates in December, which matters for risk assets like crypto. Because October 2025 prices were never collected during the government shutdown, there will be no official year-over-year rate this time, so the monthly numbers are what to watch.
points: Consensus is +0.3% for the month (September +0.6%) and core +0.2% (September +0.3%), per ZeroHedge.
Goldman expects +0.21% headline and +0.16% core, per ZeroHedge; the Cleveland Fed nowcast is 0.24% headline and 0.21% core, per BYDFi.
September's last official yearly rates were 3.7% headline and 2.6% core, per CryptoTicker.
Producer prices (PPI) follow on Friday at 8:30am ET, forecast +0.4% for the month (prior +1.3%), per ZeroHedge.

stories.title: Bitcoin and ether funds see Monday outflows; $1.2B of bets wiped out
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin and ether funds both had net outflows on Monday, and about $1.2 billion of leveraged positions were wiped out, most of them bets on higher prices.
points: Monday 9 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs -$201M net, led by BlackRock's IBIT at -$213.2M, per Farside data via KuCoin News.
Monday 9 Nov: US spot ether ETFs -$184.6M net, led by BlackRock's ETHA at -$119.3M, per the same report.
About $1.2B of positions were liquidated, $1.04B of them longs; ether accounted for $507M and bitcoin $324M, per Coinglass via KuCoin News.

stories.title: Strategy buys 1,036 BTC days before MSCI's index decision
stories.summary: Strategy, a bitcoin treasury company, filed with the SEC that it bought more bitcoin last week by selling its own shares. On Wednesday MSCI announces whether it will drop crypto-treasury companies like Strategy from its indexes, which could force index funds to sell the stock.
points: Strategy bought 1,036 BTC for $81.9M between 2 and 8 Nov, an average of $79,012 each, per its SEC filing.
It now holds 850,364 BTC bought for $64.16B in total, an average cost of $75,456, per the filing.
MSCI results come shortly after 11:00pm CET on Wed 11 Nov, with changes effective at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.
In 2025 JPMorgan estimated up to $2.8B of selling in Strategy shares if it were removed, or $8.8B if other index providers followed, per DL News citing Bloomberg.

sources.label: DL News: Strategy faces 11 Nov MSCI decision
